mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role (name, code, description, status, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM role WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM role ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT r.* FROM role r JOIN user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
